title: Admin privilege lifecycle review, SAML bindings hardening, and audit telemetry remediation
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Reduce admin attack surface and close post-pen-test findings by reviewing the admin privilege lifecycle, hardening SAML bindings/configuration, and improving audit telemetry to support immutable forensic trails. Outcomes should include a prioritized remediation backlog, implemented low-risk fixes, and follow-up validation steps (unit tests, smoke tests, and re-run of select pen-test cases).
acceptance_criteria: Threat model updated with admin privilege lifecycle and SAML binding vectors
Critical and high pen-test findings mapped to remediation tasks with owners and dates
RBAC v2 policy migration plan includes least-privilege templates and automated validation
SAML configuration hardened: strict audience, signed assertions enforced, and metadata rotation documented
Audit logging: immutable sink configured for admin actions, retention policy set, and dashboards for anomalous admin behavior live
All low-risk fixes merged to main and smoke-tested in staging; medium/high changes in canary with rollback plan
tasks: Conduct threat modeling workshop (security + infra + platform) — facilitator: Aisha Kumar
Inventory current admin principals and long-lived tokens (query: infra/identity/audit-dashboard)
Define RBAC v2 least-privilege templates for Admin, Org Admin, and Support roles
Implement automated policy linter to reject wildcard grants in PRs (github: PR #1428)
Review SAML SP/IdP bindings; enforce SignedResponse or SignedAssertion and audience checks
Rotate SAML metadata and document key rollover procedure in Confluence
Ship immutable audit sink to WORM storage for admin events and test tamper-resistance
Create telemetry alerts and dashboards for: unusual admin login locations, elevation outside canary, and admin token usage rate spikes
Address high pen-test items: CVE-like misconfigurations, exposed admin endpoints, session fixation paths
Create post-remediation validation checklist and coordinate re-test with 3rd party pen-test vendor
